Fictional historical artifact.

The Pinecone Commerce archive records 170 activated merchants of 250 eligible, or 68%. Support questions declined from 31 to 18 in the archived period. Seven merchant migrations still await confirmation. Nora Feld owns the launch decision, Eli Navarro owns reporting, and Mina Park owns engineering. The decision is to keep the staged rollout at 68% until migration checks are complete.

The seven migration owners are Nora Feld for Birch Books, Eli Navarro for Copper Coffee, Mina Park for Poppy Goods, Sam Okafor for Juniper Bikes, Jonah Brooks for Fern Market, Lena Ortiz for Oak Paper, and Maya Chen for Willow Studio.
